scientific_integrity: Exact all-size proof by matrix-tree reduction, stationary AR(1) inverse and strict log-determinant concavity; 793 supplementary independent exact-rational checks.
scientific_limitations: Fixed unit-conductance horizontal rails and two rail layers; only variable rung conductances with identical unit prices are optimized.
Spanning-tree determinant objective is not asserted to optimize arbitrary reliability or hitting-time measures.
Published specialist rung-correlation theorem inspected in full and distinguished by its uniform-weight hypothesis; independent priority nevertheless not certified.
title: Exact endpoint-enhanced D-optimal rung allocation on finite ladders
